implementation: Radar source loading requires ON and supported state/mode/age; drawing additionally requires Image.Ready. Decode alone cannot establish availability.
STALE retains permitted imagery but frame/title use caution colour rather than CURRENT cyan.
Expired, clock-skewed, unknown, missing provider/age, inconsistent simulation and invalid image fail closed.
OFF/unavailable hide simulation lightning/legend too; compact and regular badges retain failure cause.
Reported minutes are explicitly CACHE age, not observation age. No new QML age thresholds.
Runtime QML regression in CTest/Linux CI; functional binding-string checks replaced by actual component tests. Existing approved golden images/manifests unchanged.

baseline_regressions.tests: Final committed test file, two selected cases against isolated original component.
guards: Fresh decoded fixture visibility asserted in init; a hidden test surface cannot produce a false pass.

qml_runtime.warning: One intentional unsupported-image-format warning from corrupted PNG fault.
qml_runtime.method: Actual WeatherRadarOverlay.qml instantiated from source with injected provider and local generated opaque 16x16 PNG, not execution of the packaged PFD binary.
coverage: Controlled state/age sequence: 0/600/601/1200/1201/-6 seconds and recovery, regular + compact layouts.
Unknown states, OFF/recovery, missing provider, negative/non-finite/non-numeric age, simulation provenance/decorations.
Decode error/recovery, primary STALE frame colour, rendered pixel removal on expiry.
not_covered: Persistent cache reload or real network
Slow asynchronous image loading under controlled network delay

yaml_syntax.method: Existing MFD PyYAML parser, workflow supplied via stdin; no file/service change. Local Python/Node YAML parsers unavailable; no package installed.

notes: Existing separate build directory reused with Release compiler probe. No toolchain installation or security policy changes.
Python discovery selected WindowsApps alias; full golden CTest gate not registered in this local directory. CI gate unchanged and still required.
No packaged native renderer execution or native weather_service_tests execution claimed in this increment; source classifier unchanged and existing native tests remain in CI.

limitations: N10 (observation vs acquisition/cache age) remains open; availability follows the service's classified state, not an independent QML clock.
Native service cache reload is CURRENT/STALE/EXPIRED by age; no CACHED enum support invented.
No live provider, geographic alignment, licensing or panel/ARM64 acceptance.
N1/PR52 and N4/N5/PR53 remain separate candidate branches, not integrated here.
Activations blocked by power qualification. No authority inferred for other R1 blocks.
